purpose: post-hoc decomposition of the CLOSED tiearb_20260816 Stage-1 P-PARTIAL dev/holdout split, for successor DESIGN only. Adjudicates nothing, re-labels nothing, modifies nothing under tiearb_20260816/.
note_arm_count: n_arms_planned == n_arms_scored for all 733 records; arm_count uses n_arms_scored.

metric_variants._all: per-position value * scale_all (per-STRATUM constant: e4 0.767677, selfplay 0.722103). THIS IS THE PUBLISHED HEADLINE VARIANT -- READOUT.statistics.dev.arb_all.mean = +0.2919885, READOUT.statistics.holdout.arb_all.mean = -0.0051344.
metric_variants._discriminable: the raw per-position field, unscaled; reproduces READOUT.statistics.*.*_discriminable.

slice_gaps._note_se_diff: roots are disjoint between slices (verified: 0 shared roots), so se_diff = sqrt(se_dev^2 + se_hold^2)

standardization._method: predicted_slice_mean = sum_levels frac_in_slice(level) * pooled_level_mean(level); pooled level means from all 733 positions (section pooled_per_level_means).

reweighting._method: holdout positions weighted by frac_dev(level)/frac_holdout(level); weighted mean + weighted cluster-robust sandwich on root_id. frac_of_gap_closed = (gap_raw - gap_after_reweight)/gap_raw.

dispersion_and_design_effect._note: deff_se_ratio = cluster_robust_se / (sd/sqrt(n)); deff_variance_ratio is its square (the n-inflation factor for successor power arithmetic).

permutation_placebo._method: B=2000 root-level reassignments of the slice label (120 of 399 roots to 'holdout', preserving each root's position count); pooled per-level means held FIXED at their observed values. Gives the null scale of a composition-predicted gap and an empirical check on se_gap.

headline.key_observation: the random-arm baseline rnd_all moves MORE across the slices (gap +0.3978, z +2.97) than arb_all does (gap +0.2971, z +2.53), and the mechanism-net contrast arb_minus_rnd_all is NOT lower on holdout (dev +0.1624 vs holdout +0.2630, gap -0.1007, z -0.71).
headline.sparsity_flag: phase_x_arm_count has 12 cells; smallest holdout cell n=4, so its frac_explained is the most optimistic number here -- read it against permutation_placebo.phase_x_arm_count.
headline.caveat: post-hoc, covariates chosen after seeing the split; adjudicates nothing. Design input only.
